# trust-manager

trust-manager, distributing the lab's CA into every namespace that needs it.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bundleName | string | `"lab-ca-bundle"` | Name of the ConfigMap the CA lands in, in every namespace. |
| chart | string | `upstream.chart` | Store path of the trust-manager Helm chart. Required. |
| namespace | string | `"cert-manager"` | Namespace the controller runs in, and the one it reads Bundle sources from. Defaults to cert-manager's, because the CA Secret it reads is there and the controller only looks in one.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| issuance | [X509_ISSUANCE](../signatures/X509_ISSUANCE.md) | Something that signs certificates, and whether a browser will trust what it signs. |
| webhook | [X509_WEBHOOK](../signatures/X509_WEBHOOK.md) | The certificate controller's admission webhook is serving, so its CRs are accepted. |

| trust | [TRUST_BUNDLE](../signatures/TRUST_BUNDLE.md) | A CA bundle distributed into namespaces, for workloads that verify the lab's own certificates. |
